# SapinSapin AI

> An open initiative building corpora, benchmarks, and models for Philippine-language AI — speech recognition, text-to-speech, language models, and pretraining text corpora across 10+ languages, including Filipino, Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon, Bikol, Pangasinan, Kapampangan, Tausug, and Waray.

Every dataset and model is openly published on Hugging Face. Figures on sapinsapin.ai are synced from the Hub at build time — the Hub itself is the source of record for counts, licenses, and gated status. The counts in this file are filled in from the same snapshot when the site is built.

## Datasets

{{DATASET_COUNT}} public datasets on the Hub. The main ones:

- [Philippine Language Dataset (PLD)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/pld): 334,268 utterances, 448.2 hours of prompted 16 kHz speech across nine Philippine languages and English (UP-DSP research license)
- [Filipino Speech Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/filipinospeechcorpus): 305,246 published rows; 65.1 hours across 313,322 segments, mostly isolated words (MIT license)
- [kumu-livestream-segmented](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/kumu-livestream-segmented) and [kumu-livestream-raw](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/kumu-livestream-raw): Taglish livestream speech; access-controlled (gated) under research-use and speaker-protection terms
- [BantayWika](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/BantayWika): 6.09M tokens of Filipino, Cebuano, and Ilocano text, derived from the UP Sentro ng Wikang Filipino and UP-DSP Bantay-Wika collection
- [halohalo](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/halohalo): 19.18M tokens across 16,727 documents of cleaned Tagalog, Hiligaynon, and Bikol web text; combines [halo-tgl](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/halo-tgl), [halo-hil](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/halo-hil), and [halo-bcl](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sapinsapin/halo-bcl)

## Models

{{MODEL_COUNT}} public models on the Hub, spanning speech recognition (Whisper and OmniASR fine-tunes), text-to-speech (SpeechT5 and Orpheus fine-tunes), voice conversion, language identification (halo-lid, WikaLID), and text generation (Llama 3.1 and gpt-oss-20b continued pretraining on Filipino news, a Qwen-SEA-LION Filipino news writer, and bikoLLM for Bikol). Full catalog: https://huggingface.co/sapinsapin

## Live demo

- [halohalo Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/sapinsapin/halohalo-dashboard): transcribe, synthesize, and convert voice in Philippine languages, callable directly from the browser
- Ask Sappy: a chat assistant on sapinsapin.ai and the project Discord that answers questions about SapinSapin AI from a sourced knowledge base

The demo covers the speech models only. The text and language models are on the Hub rather than in the demo.

## Notes for automated use

Licenses are dataset- and model-specific — MIT, the UP-DSP research license, Apache-2.0, CC BY-NC 4.0, the Llama 3.1 Community License and custom licenses all appear in the current catalog, and some datasets are gated. Check the individual Hugging Face card before reuse, especially for commercial use. Figures reported as "downloads" on sapinsapin.ai are the Hub's 30-day download count, not lifetime totals.
